recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create “Consensus Scramble: Awkward Office Cut,” a portrait-first browser game preserving a single central tap target, progress meter, transformation reveal, win overlay, and restart flow. Rebuild presentation as workplace cringe comedy: Pat from Ops stands in a procedural cubicle scene under a deadpan documentary REC overlay. Each valid tap is an awkward approval that fills the Consensus Meter, emits forced-laugh copy and office-paper particles, and after 20 approvals triggers a memo storm and accidental promotion. Use mobile-safe buttons, readable HUD text, vanilla Canvas/CSS/JS, and approved catalog fonts/audio only.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: single-screen tap-to-progress transformation toy / clicker
- objective: tap the central tall character until a meter reaches 20 required approvals, then watch a transformation and win overlay
- input model: start/restart buttons use native click; active play uses pointerdown on the canvas with a generous vertical-column hitbox
- core loop: start -> tap central actor -> increment progress -> spawn particles/floating text -> at cap trigger reveal -> show terminal overlay -> restart
- fail/friction state: no loss state; friction is missed taps outside the hit column and waiting through the reveal timing

## Protected Mechanics
- 20-tap default progress requirement, configurable through gameConfigDefs.
- Canvas pointerdown hit detection preserves the broad center-column contact model.
- Progress bar, shake, particles, reveal delay, transformed actor, win modal, audio unlock, and restart flow remain intact.

## Transformable Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/copy, actor silhouette, particles, background, colors, fonts, audio labels, and feedback notes are presentation-only and safe to reauthor.
